title.narrative: Second Forum on Transformative Education for ASPnet Teachers and Youth of Lebanon “Building peaceful and sustainable futures through transformative education”

description.narrative:
The Forum will include two parallel workshops one address to teachers and another one for students that will tackle the Transformative Education areas of: • Greening education based on the Whole school approach on climate change (Get climate ready) • Introducing Artificial Intelligence into Teaching and Learning • Media literacy : critical thinking , raising voices of youth, • the importance of Social Emotional Learning in schools (SEL) Social emotional learning
The two face to face workshops, each one for two days, addressed to ASPnet teachers and Youth, will be followed by a national competition on the best four projects that tackle one of the areas or topic of the Forum in line with SDG’s goals.
